edits.text:
4. ASSIGNMENT. (a) Except for a Permitted Transfer under paragraph (b), the Tenant shall not assign this Lease without the Landlord’s prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed. The Tenant shall provide information reasonably necessary to assess the proposed assignee’s financial capacity, proposed use of the Premises and ability to perform the Tenant’s obligations. The Landlord shall respond in writing within fifteen business days after receiving the request and such information, giving reasonable particulars of any refusal or conditions. Failure to respond shall not constitute consent. Consent shall not be conditioned on an increase in rent or other amendment of this Lease unrelated to the proposed assignment.
(b) A “Permitted Transfer” means an assignment to an entity controlling, controlled by or under common control with the Tenant, or to a successor in a bona fide merger, consolidation or sale of substantially all of the Tenant’s business assets, provided that: (i) the transfer is not principally undertaken to evade this clause; (ii) the assignee has financial capacity reasonably sufficient to perform the Tenant’s obligations; (iii) the permitted use of the Premises does not change; and (iv) the assignee assumes in writing all Tenant obligations under this Lease. No Landlord consent is required for a Permitted Transfer. The Tenant shall give at least ten business days’ prior written notice and reasonable evidence of compliance with these conditions; where advance notice is prohibited by applicable law, notice shall be given promptly when legally permitted.
(c) Every assignee shall assume in writing the Tenant’s obligations under this Lease, and a copy of that assumption shall be delivered to the Landlord. No assignment releases the original Tenant from liability unless the Landlord expressly agrees in writing. Consent to one assignment does not waive the requirements applicable to any subsequent assignment.

Proposed for discussion only, subject to both clients’ instructions and agreement of the complete lease. Please confirm the consent standard, response and notice periods, and permitted-transfer conditions. Please also confirm whether subletting and changes of control should be addressed expressly; neither is resolved by this proposal.
